def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    if not n:
        return []
    m = len(grid[0])
    # A consecutive run of nonzero full-width rows is the period motif.
    colored = []
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if all(v == row[0] for v in row) and row[0] != 0:
            colored.append((r, row[0]))
    # Use the longest consecutive run; repeat it vertically across the grid.
    runs = []
    run = []
    prev = None
    for r, v in colored:
        if prev is None or r == prev + 1:
            run.append(v)
        else:
            runs.append(run)
            run = [v]
        prev = r
    if run:
        runs.append(run)
    motif = max(runs, key=len) if runs else []
    if not motif:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Align repeated motif to the start of its observed run.
    start = next(r for r, v in colored if len(motif) and all(
        (r+i, motif[i]) in colored for i in range(len(motif))))
    return [[motif[(r-start) % len(motif)]] * m for r in range(n)]
PY

def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    if not n:
        return []
    m = len(grid[0])
    known = {}
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        vals = {v for v in row if v != 0}
        if len(vals) == 1 and all(v != 0 for v in row):
            known[r] = next(iter(vals))
        elif any(v != 0 for v in row):
            return [row[:] for row in grid]
    for p in range(1, n + 1):
        motif = [None] * p
        ok = True
        for r, v in known.items():
            k = r % p
            if motif[k] is not None and motif[k] != v:
                ok = False
                break
            motif[k] = v
        if ok and all(v is not None for v in motif):
            return [[motif[r % p]] * m for r in range(n)]
    return [row[:] for row in grid]
PY
